simple.summary: דַּנָּה (Dannâh) means Dannah , a place in Palestine First listed occurrence: Josh 15 49.

definitions.full: H1837. Dannah דַּנָּה proper name, of a location a city of Judah 'in the hill country,' named just before Kiryath Sanna = Debîr (= Kiryath Sepher ), Josh 15:49 ᵐ5 Ῥεννα .
